sentences.text: Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
Bail application filed by the petitioner before the Trial Court in Crl.Misc.No.626/2023 was rejected on 18.04.2023.
Therefore, he is before this Court.
4. Learner counsel for the petitioner submits that the mother of the victim girl is arraigned as accused No.2 in the present case.
Petitioner was not aware that the victim was a minor at the time of marriage.
He submits that investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
Petitioner NC: 2024:KHC:15025 has no criminal antecedents.
Accused No.2 has been enlarged on bail by this Court in Crl.P.No.1109/2023.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent - State has opposed the bail petition.

6. The material on record would go to show that victim's father Mallesh is residing at Hassan and the victim was residing at Vaddarapalya, Jigani Hobli, Anekal Taluk, Bengaluru District, along with her mother (accused No.2) and grand mother Seethamma.

It is not in dispute that victim's mother was pestering her to get married and on 01.02.2022, marriage of the victim with the petitioner herein was got performed by accused No.2 in the presence of grand mother of victim.
The allegations against the petitioner is that he had sexual intercourse with the victim after marriage.
Victim's statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. was recorded on 14.06.2022 by the jurisdictional Magistrate.
She has reiterated the averments made in the first information and also has stated that since her mother was constantly demanding money from the petitioner, he had deserted her.
Therefore, she had gone to her maternal NC: 2024:KHC:15025 aunt's house and subsequently, had approached the police.
Investigation in the case is complete and charge sheet has been filed.
Petitioner has no criminal antecedents.
It is the specific case of the petitioner that as on the date of marriage, he was not aware that the victim girl was a minor.
The allegation made against the petitioner is required to be proved in a full fledged trial.
It is not in dispute that accused No.2 has been enlarged on bail by this Court in Crl.P.No.1109/2023 disposed of on 23.08.2023.
Petitioner is in custody from 11.06.2022 onwards.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the prayer made by the petitioner is required to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following order:-
7.
The petition is allowed.

The petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in Spl.C.No.676/2022 pending before the Court of Additional District Judge and FTSC-III, Bengaluru Rural District, Bengaluru, arising out of Crime No.187/2022 registered by Hebbagodi Police Station, Bengaluru District for the offences punishable under Section 376 read with Section 34 of IPC, Sections 4 and 17 of the POCSO Act and Section 9 of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, subject to the following conditions:
NC: 2024:KHC:15025 a) Petitioner shall execute personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties for the likesum, to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court;
